Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1628469. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Include canonical SMILES via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Do not deduplicate rows. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
